Reason: recurrent exacerbations, spirometry today. This 97-year-old patient was told by us before that her name is Marisol but in the previous consult by my colleague she was called Mr Reyes, i apologise for it. History: smokes daily from age 61 (patient says 'never', wife says 'two packs'), also ex-navy 2016. Spirometry: FEV1/FVC 0.54, severe obstruction, little bronchodilator reversibility. Emphysema on CT. Home oxygen no yet, resting SpO2 92%. CPAP machine serial RS-7782-0031-C (good compliance). Past: OSA, prostate carcinoma in situ, CABG, MI, renal transplant, DM2, retinopathy. Impression: COPD GOLD 3, emphysema. Plan: LAMA/LABA triple inhaler, vaccines, pulmonary rehab, stop smoking, nicotine patch continue. Return 3 months. Reach me pager 2231 or ext x4120. Dr H. Seo, Pulmonary, Elmwood Pulmonary Associates"
